watch_rule: beyond 2 SD of the personal 14-day baseline for 3 days in a row
remeasure_rule: single reading more than 3 SD away from the personal day-to-day change

indicators.label: Blood pressure
indicators.how_to_measure: Rest 5 min with feet anchored; cuff on bare left upper arm at heart level; do not talk.
indicators.why_in_space: Without gravity, body fluids shift toward the head and the heart and vessels adapt; cabin CO2 can add headaches.

actions.self_care: Drink 500 mL water, check cabin CO2, 15 min quiet rest, re-check at 19:00
actions.crew: Tell the crew medical officer if still above 140/90 tonight
actions.flight_surgeon: Send the 30-day trend report if still high tomorrow

indicators.label: Resting heart rate
indicators.why_in_space: The heart adapts to doing less work against gravity.

source.title: NASA HRP resources linked from the challenge page

indicators.label: Oxygen saturation
indicators.how_to_measure: Wearable, or handheld pulse oximeter on a warm finger.
indicators.why_in_space: Cabin air problems or illness can lower blood oxygen.

source.title: NASA HRP resources linked from the challenge page

indicators.label: Blood sugar (fasting)
indicators.why_in_space: Inactivity and diet changes can affect how the body handles sugar.

source.title: NASA HRP resources linked from the challenge page

indicators.label: Body temperature
indicators.how_to_measure: Thermometer under the tongue, 5 min after drinking.
indicators.why_in_space: Immune changes in flight can make infections more likely.

source.title: NASA HRP resources linked from the challenge page

indicators.label: Sleep
indicators.why_in_space: Isolation, noise and a disrupted light-dark cycle shorten sleep.

source.title: NASA HRP resources linked from the challenge page

indicators.label: Mood & stress
indicators.how_to_measure: Tap how you feel today; there is no objective mood sensor.
indicators.why_in_space: Long isolation and confinement strain mood and focus.

source.title: NASA HRP resources linked from the challenge page

indicators.label: Bone loading / bone forecast
indicators.how_to_measure: Bone density cannot be scanned in flight (DXA happens on Earth before and after); the app tracks exercise and forecasts.
indicators.why_in_space: Without load, weight-bearing bones lose mineral; resistance exercise is the main countermeasure.

indicators.label: Radiation dose
indicators.how_to_measure: Read automatically from the onboard dosimeter.
indicators.why_in_space: Outside Earth's magnetic field, cosmic rays and solar storms raise long-term health risks.

actions.self_care: Move to the storm shelter during a solar particle event
